# U43: An admin marks someone as left: first who takes over their goals and asks, then they leave every list, and history keeps their name

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `PERSON-LEFT`, `UNDO-REMOVE`, `REMOVE-ANYTHING`
- **Budget:** at most 10 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/people` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U43

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/people` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s heading area shows.
- **Step.** Type “Mateo” into the field showing “Find by name, job title or team”.
- **Step.** Press the “Mateo Fernández” link.
- **Step.** Press the “Mark as left…” button.
- **Check:** The “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog shows.
- _Note:_ It asks who takes over first: marking him as left with no one chosen says what's missing and saves nothing.
- **Check:** “Who takes over Mateo’s {owned.length} goal” is shown in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog (else: the dialog does not ask who takes over his goals).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark as left” button in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog.
- **Check:** “Choose who takes them over.” is shown in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog (else: marking him as left with no one chosen did not say what was missing).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `!(await h.snapshot()).people.find((x) => x.id === 'mateo').leftAt`. Else it says: he was marked as left with no one taking over.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “mark as left”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Find and pick: press “Who takes over Mateo’s N goals” in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog, type “marisol”, and choose “Marisol Duarte”.
- **Step.** Press the “Mark as left” button in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog.
- **Check:** “Mateo Fernández is marked as left” is shown (else: no message that he left).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the button in the message that pops up showing “Undo” is visible (else: the message has no Undo).
- _Note:_ Gone from the directory; on Recently removed (its own section), with Restore.
- **Check:** “Left Platform Engineering on” is shown (else: his page does not say he left).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `title === 'Mateo Fernández (left)'`, where `const title = (await p.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 }).first().innerText()).trim()`. Else it says: his page is titled “{title}”, not “Mateo Fernández (left)”.
- Go to `/people?q=Mateo` in the demo.
- **Check:** “No person matches “Mateo”.” is shown (else: Mateo is still in the directory).
- Go to `/workspace/removed` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Person who left” is shown in the removed block (`.removed-block`) (else: Recently removed does not list him).
- **Check:** “Mateo Fernández” is shown in the removed block (`.removed-block`).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “after”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!m.leftAt && m.leftBy === 'grace' && handed && open === 0`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const cycle = liveCycle(s0).id`; `const owned = s0.goals.filter((g) => g.ownerId === 'mateo' && g.cycleId === cycle && !g.removedAt && !g.stoppedAt).map((g) => g.id)`; `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const m = s1.people.find((x) => x.id === 'mateo')`; `const handed = owned.every((id) => s1.goals.find((g) => g.id === id).ownerId === 'marisol')`; `const open = (s1.requests || []).filter((r) => r.status === 'open' && (r.askedBy === 'mateo' || r.recipientId === 'mateo')).length`. Else it says: left {m.leftAt}; goals handed over {handed}; {open} open asks still his.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `log.some((c) => c.entity === 'person' && c.action === 'left' && c.entityId === 'mateo') && log.filter((c) => c.entity === 'goal' && /as Mateo Fernández left/.test(c.summary)).length === owned.length`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const cycle = liveCycle(s0).id`; `const owned = s0.goals.filter((g) => g.ownerId === 'mateo' && g.cycleId === cycle && !g.removedAt && !g.stoppedAt).map((g) => g.id)`; `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const log = s1.changes.filter((c) => c.at > (s0.changes.at(-1)?.at ?? ''))`. Else it says: logged: {worked out in the journey as `log.map((c) => c.summary).join(' | ').slice(0, 200)`}.
- _Note:_ History keeps his name, as "Name (left)".
- Go to `/activity?who=mateo` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Mateo Fernández (left)” is shown (else: Activity does not name him as having left).
- Close this browser.
